_doc: The consent window's rules (integrations.consent in config/forge.json; hooks/guard_tool_use.py --consent reads this file on every call, forge sync never does). adapter: "omarchy", or a path inside scripts/consent/ of this checkout; anything else is refused, because Write and Edit do not pass through the Bash guard and an arbitrary path would switch the window off. timeout_s: how long the adapter may wait for a person before the call is denied. rules: match is "production.branches" (a git push to a branch a profile lists) or "production.commands" (a command prefix or an exact MCP tool name a profile lists); risks are shown in the window and cannot be empty. Unknown keys are an error. With this file broken every Bash and MCP call is refused: set integrations.consent to false in config/forge.json and run forge sync --apply to take the hook row out.
